title: The Vacuolar Ca(2+)/H(+) Exchanger AaVCX Regulates Calcium Homeostasis, the Differentiation of Infection Structures and Pathogenicity in Alternaria alternata Under the Transcriptional Control of AaCrz1.
authors: Yang, Yangyang; Xie, Pengdong; Liu, Qili; Nan, Yuanping; Zhang, Miao; Wang, Xiaojing; Bi, Yang; Li, Yongcai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌钙信号通路中转录因子AaCrz1对钙转运蛋白AaVCX的转录调控，包含分子对接预测TF-DNA结合，但核心是生物学功能而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法上仅简单对接，AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: Calcium ion (Ca(2+)) signalling is crucial for multiple biological processes in fungi, including growth, stress adaptation and pathogenic behaviour. The vacuolar Ca(2+)/H(+) exchanger (VCX) is vital for maintaining calcium homeostasis within fungal cells, yet its specific biological functions in phytopathogenic fungi remain poorly understood. This study focused on the role and transcriptional regulation of AaVCX in Alternaria alternata, the organism responsible for pear black spot disease. By employing a split-marker strategy, we generated AaVCX knockout (DeltaAaVCX) and complemented (DeltaAaVCX-C) strains. Phenotypic assessments revealed that DeltaAaVCX exhibited reduced mycelial growth, abnormal accumulation of intracellular Ca(2+) and heightened sensitivity to various stressors. Deletion of AaVCX severely hindered spore germination, differentiation of appressoria and invasive hyphae in A. alternata triggered by pear peel wax. The DeltaAaVCX nearly lost its ability to penetrate cellophane, and its virulence on pear fruits and leaves was markedly diminished. Molecular docking analysis indicated that AaCrz1, a key transcription factor in the calcium signalling pathway, can bind to the promoter of AaVCX. Dual-luciferase and yeast one-hybrid assays demonstrated that AaCrz1 binds to the AaVCX promoter in vitro and positively regulates its expression, with a predicted GCC-core motif identified in the promoter region. Furthermore, transcript levels of AaVCX were significantly reduced in the DeltaAaCrz1 background, indicating that AaVCX is positioned downstream of AaCrz1 in a regulatory cascade. Our findings enhance the understanding of calcium signalling networks in phytopathogenic fungi and propose that components involved in vacuolar calcium storage may serve as potential targets for disease management.
abstract_zh: 钙离子（Ca(2+)）信号传导对真菌的多种生物学过程至关重要，包括生长、应激适应和致病行为。液泡Ca(2+)/H(+)交换器（VCX）在维持真菌细胞内钙稳态中起关键作用，但其在植物病原真菌中的具体生物学功能仍知之甚少。本研究聚焦于梨黑斑病病原菌链格孢（Alternaria alternata）中AaVCX的作用及其转录调控。通过采用split-marker策略，我们生成了AaVCX敲除（DeltaAaVCX）和互补（DeltaAaVCX-C）菌株。表型评估显示，DeltaAaVCX表现出菌丝生长减少、细胞内Ca(2+)异常积累以及对多种胁迫因子的敏感性增强。AaVCX的缺失严重阻碍了由梨果皮蜡诱导的A. alternata孢子萌发、附着胞分化和侵入菌丝的形成。DeltaAaVCX几乎丧失穿透玻璃纸的能力，其在梨果实和叶片上的致病力显著降低。分子对接分析表明，钙信号通路中的关键转录因子AaCrz1可结合至AaVCX的启动子。双荧光素酶和酵母单杂交实验证明，AaCrz1在体外结合AaVCX启动子并正向调控其表达，且在启动子区域预测到一个GCC核心基序。此外，在DeltaAaCrz1背景下，AaVCX的转录水平显著降低，表明AaVCX位于AaCrz1下游的调控级联中。我们的发现增进了对植物病原真菌钙信号网络的理解，并提出液泡钙储存相关组分可能作为病害管理的潜在靶点。
